The equation for the reaction of metal M with aqueous zinc sulfate is shown.
M(s)+ZnSO4(aq)→MSO4(aq)+Zn(s)
Which statement explains why metal M reacts with aqueous zinc sulfate?
A
Zinc is less reactive than M because M is able to accept electrons from zinc ions.
B
Zinc is a more powerful reducing agent than M.
C
Zinc is more reactive than M because it can lose electrons more easily than M.
D
Zinc ions can remove electrons from M.

options.label: A
options.text: Zinc is less reactive than M because M is able to accept electrons from zinc ions.

options.label: B
options.text: Zinc is a more powerful reducing agent than M.

options.label: C
options.text: Zinc is more reactive than M because it can lose electrons more easily than M.

options.label: D
options.text: Zinc ions can remove electrons from M.
